text: An Inkblood ritual at midnight can reveal the true name of any spirit in the Reach.
The Compact is offering binding contracts that grant immunity to bloom infection.
The sealed ossuary beneath the Reach has been opened. Something walked out.
The Compact keeps a ledger of every favor owed. Your name may be in it already.
The tithe of bone has doubled. The Compact says the dead demand more each season.
A scribe smuggled out a forbidden text. The Compact wants it back, quietly.
They say the Compact can return the dead — for a price no one should pay.
The deep archive flooded with black ink. The records it held are lost — or hidden.
